notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.intro: Choose what Maison Oud may notify you about on your phone or computer. Order emails are always sent.
notifications.ordersHint: Confirmed, shipped, out for delivery, delivered.
notifications.backInStockHint: When something you asked about returns.
notifications.priceDropHint: When a piece on your wishlist costs less.
notifications.abandonedBagHint: A gentle reminder if you leave pieces in your bag.
notifications.newsHint: Occasional announcements. At most a few a week.
notifications.marketingNote: Price drops, bag reminders and news also follow your email marketing choice.

support.intro: Questions about an order, a return or a scent? Write to us — the atelier replies within a day.
